summary_md:
# Andersson: Fastighetsaktier har fått för mycket stryk

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest Robert Andersson (DI small-cap analyst) doubts that a broad Swedish small-cap recovery is near. Earnings estimates for Swedish small caps have been revised about 3% lower this year, while the S&P 500 and Europe have seen positive revisions, and he wants to see earnings turn before buying the small-cap index. He is cautious on real estate and prefers logistics over residential and office. He sees value in individual stocks: he thinks the 20% fall in Asker after DNB Carnegie's sell call went too far, he calls RVRC and New Wave too cheap, and he suggests US private credit BDCs as a contrarian high-yield idea.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ASKER — Asker | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest holds it and thinks the 20% fall after DNB Carnegie's sell call is overdone; he is more positive short term because of the drop.

#### Reasoning

Guest (portfolio holder) accepts that DNB Carnegie has valid points on aggressive classification of items affecting comparability and will adjust his own estimates. He still sees Asker as a good, profitable company, and its weaker cash conversion is partly explained by heavy investment in 2025. He considers a 20% drop an overreaction. The burden of proof is now on the company to show fewer comparability-affecting costs in 2026.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Asker keeps reporting large items affecting comparability in 2026
- if cash flow conversion does not improve
- if more accounting issues emerge

> *"Är det värt ett 20-procentigt ras? Nej, det tycker jag känns överdrivet. Vilket gör att jag på väldigt kort sikt blir mer positiv av det här på grund av raset."*

---

### 🟢 RVRC — RVRC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest's pick to watch this autumn: beaten down too much, low multiples, not losing market share.

#### Reasoning

Guest picks RVRC as a stock to follow this autumn. The market for outdoor and sports clothing is tough and will probably stay tough. But the company is executing well, is not losing market share, and trades on very low multiples, so he sees the shares as mispriced.

#### Sell Triggers

- if RVRC starts losing market share
- if the clothing market deteriorates further and hits margins

> *"De har fått alldeles för mycket stryk. Det är två bolag som gör det väldigt bra... Då tycker jag faktiskt att aktierna handlas alldeles för lågt."*

---

### 🟢 NEWA-B — New Wave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Paired with RVRC: clothing/outdoor stock beaten down too much, low multiples, strong execution.

#### Reasoning

Guest groups New Wave with RVRC as clothing, outdoor and sports companies in a tough market that are still performing well and keeping market share. He thinks the low valuation multiples mean the shares trade too cheaply.

#### Sell Triggers

- if New Wave starts losing market share
- if demand in the clothing market worsens sharply

> *"Men multiplarna är väldigt låga och de gör rätt saker. Det är inte att de tappar marknadsandelar."*

---

### 🟠 CAST — Castellum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest praises Castellum's asset sales and buybacks at a discount but avoids broad real estate exposure and is negative on office.

#### Reasoning

Guest likes Castellum's strategy of selling properties and buying back shares when the stock trades at a large discount to book value, calling it working for shareholders. However, he does not dare to be overweight real estate because of rising interest rates. He is also most negative on residential and office, which is Castellum's core segment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates keep rising
- if book values prove inflated
- if the buyback strategy stops

> *"Det är bara att kolla på Castellum och Gott."*
